title: Running Sum of 1d Array

statement.hi: Ek integer array `nums` diya hai. Uska **running sum** return karo, jahan `runningSum[i] = nums[0] + nums[1] + ... + nums[i]`.
statement.en: Given an integer array `nums`, return its **running sum**, where `runningSum[i] = nums[0] + nums[1] + ... + nums[i]`.

hi: Har index ka answer pichhle index ke answer se kaise juda hai?
Ek variable me ab tak ka sum rakho aur har step pe add karo.
en: How is the answer at index i related to the answer at index i-1?
Keep the sum so far in a variable and add each element to it.

approach.hi: Ek variable `sum` me prefix sum rakho. Har element ko add karo aur result me push karo. O(n) time, O(1) extra space (output ke alawa).
approach.en: Keep a prefix sum in a variable `sum`. Add each element and push the current sum to the result. O(n) time, O(1) extra space besides the output.
